channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: MEA Advisory Issued: Indians Urged to Leave Iran as Security Situation Deteriorates
item.description: As protests and instability persist in Iran, India’s MEA has advised citizens to avoid non-essential travel and remain vigilant or leave if possible.

item.title: Kargil Rally Backs Ayatollah Khamenei Amid Iran Anti-Regime Protests, Waves Indian and Iranian Flags Together
item.description: A pro-Khamenei protest in Kargil highlights how Iran’s ongoing unrest is resonating within Indian communities.

item.title: Turning Winter into Warmth: Wishes and Blessings Steps Up Relief for North India’s Most Vulnerable
item.description: As a harsh cold wave grips North India, Wishes and Blessings is delivering warmth, dignity, and hope to vulnerable communities.

item.title: UK Temporarily Closes Tehran Embassy as Security Deteriorates Amid Iran Crackdown and Rising US Threats
item.description: Britain shuts its Tehran embassy and pulls out staff as security risks mount amid Iranian crackdowns.

item.title: I-PAC Raids: ED Tells Calcutta High Court Nothing Was Seized, Alleges Mamata Banerjee Took Materials
item.description: ED claims Mamata Banerjee "physically took away" raided I-PAC documents; agency seeks CBI probe into obstruction.

item.title: Second Fire in Two Days at Prayagraj’s Magh Mela Triggers Panic, Raises Safety Concerns
item.description: Two fire incidents in consecutive days at Prayagraj’s Magh Mela were contained without casualties, but have raised serious concerns over safety preparedness at large religious gatherings.

item.title: Supreme Court Orders Binding Rules to Enforce 25% EWS Quota Across Schools, Calls It National Mission
item.description: Supreme Court orders states to frame binding rules for the 25% RTE quota, calling it a "national mission."

item.title: Kite Flying Turns Fatal as Chinese Manjha Kills Four On Makar Sankranti Across Indian States: Reports
item.description: At least four people died on Makar Sankranti as illegal nylon kite strings caused fatal injuries across India.

item.title: Raipur: 55-Year-Old Ansari Lures 5-Year-Old Girl with Chocolates, Rapes Her 5 Days, Arrested After Threats Exposed
item.description: Raipur shopkeeper, 55, raped 5-year-old neighbour with chocolate lures, threats; arrested after her pain revelation.

item.title: US Suspends Immigrant Visas For 75 Nations; Cites ‘Public Charge’ Risks And Welfare Abuse Concerns
item.description: US pauses immigrant visas for 75 countries starting Jan 21 to prevent applicants from becoming "public charges."
